    //==
    // # The IMeshIncidence rung for PolygonMesh3D
    //
    // The six incidence queries of `IMeshIncidence` (`topology.concepts.plato`),
    // answered from the packed corner table with no stored adjacency structure. This
    // is the middle rung of the topology ladder: enough to walk the mesh, split it
    // into components, and classify manifoldness, without committing to a built
    // stored half-edge structure.
    //
    // Unlike the ring walks above, nothing here
    // requires a closed manifold: every body is a corner scan, and a boundary edge —
    // whose corner has no twin — is reported as an edge with one incident face.
    //
    // Cost: `CornerUndirectedEdge` is already quadratic in corner count, so the
    // scans that call it per corner are cubic. That is the accepted trade for the
    // catalog solids this representation serves (a truncated icosahedron has 180
    // corners); a stored side table is separate work.
    //
    // Non-manifold limitation: `TwinCorner` resolves to a single opposite corner, so
    // an edge shared by three or more faces cannot be represented faithfully and
    // `FacesOfUndirectedEdge` reports at most two. `IsNonManifoldUndirectedEdge`
    // (`meshes.library.plato`) therefore never fires for this type.

    //==
    // Locating an edge's naming corner.

    // The canonical corner that names an undirected edge, or the "none" index if
    // no corner does. The inverse of `CornerUndirectedEdge`.
    // Convention: see CONVENTIONS.md - Typed indices - -1 means none.
    CanonicalCornerOfUndirectedEdge(self: PolygonMesh3D, edge: UndirectedEdgeIndex): CornerIndex
        => CornerIndex(self.CornerCount
            .MapRange(c => CornerIndex(c))
            .Reduce(-1, (found, c) =>
                self.IsCanonicalCorner(c).And(self.CornerUndirectedEdge(c).Equals(edge))
                    ? c.Value
                    : found));

    // True when either end of the directed edge a corner runs is this vertex.
    CornerTouchesVertex(self: PolygonMesh3D, corner: CornerIndex, vertex: VertexIndex): Boolean
        => self.CornerVertex(corner).Equals(vertex)
            .Or(self.CornerDestination(corner).Equals(vertex));

    //==
    // IMeshIncidence obligations — face side.

    // The corner loop of a face, counter-clockwise: the face's own row of the
    // packed table.
    VerticesOfFace(self: PolygonMesh3D, face: FaceIndex): Array<VertexIndex>
        => self.Faces.Row(face.Value);

    // The undirected edges bounding a face, one per corner, in corner order.
    UndirectedEdgesOfFace(self: PolygonMesh3D, face: FaceIndex): Array<UndirectedEdgeIndex>
        => self.FaceArity(face.Value)
            .MapRange(slot => self.CornerUndirectedEdge(self.FaceCorner(face.Value, slot)));

    //==
    // IMeshIncidence obligations — vertex side.

    // Every face using a vertex, in ascending corner order. An empty result means
    // an isolated vertex. Ascending corner order rather than rotation order, so
    // the answer does not depend on the vertex ring closing.
    FacesOfVertex(self: PolygonMesh3D, vertex: VertexIndex): Array<FaceIndex>
        => self.CornerCount
            .MapRange(c => CornerIndex(c))
            .Reduce(Repeat(0, FaceIndex(0)),
                (acc, c) => self.CornerVertex(c).Equals(vertex)
                    ? acc.Append(self.CornerFace(c))
                    : acc);

    // Every undirected edge with this vertex as an endpoint, each once. Folded
    // over canonical corners only, which is what makes it once rather than twice.
    UndirectedEdgesOfVertex(self: PolygonMesh3D, vertex: VertexIndex): Array<UndirectedEdgeIndex>
        => self.CornerCount
            .MapRange(c => CornerIndex(c))
            .Reduce(Repeat(0, UndirectedEdgeIndex(0)),
                (acc, c) => self.IsCanonicalCorner(c).And(self.CornerTouchesVertex(c, vertex))
                    ? acc.Append(self.CornerUndirectedEdge(c))
                    : acc);

    //==
    // IMeshIncidence obligations — edge side.

    // The two endpoints of an undirected edge, ordered A.Value <= B.Value to
    // match the canonical ordering of `UndirectedEdgeList`
    // (`topology.types.plato`). Direction is not recoverable from an
    // undirected edge; read the naming corner for that.
    VerticesOfUndirectedEdge(self: PolygonMesh3D, edge: UndirectedEdgeIndex): VertexPair
    {
        var corner = self.CanonicalCornerOfUndirectedEdge(edge);
        var a = self.CornerVertex(corner);
        var b = self.CornerDestination(corner);
        return a.Value <= b.Value ? (a, b) : (b, a);
    }

    // The faces meeting at an undirected edge: two for an interior edge, one for
    // a boundary edge. Read from the naming corner and its twin rather than by
    // scanning, which keeps this quadratic instead of cubic.
    FacesOfUndirectedEdge(self: PolygonMesh3D, edge: UndirectedEdgeIndex): Array<FaceIndex>
    {
        var corner = self.CanonicalCornerOfUndirectedEdge(edge);
        var twin = self.TwinCorner(corner);
        return twin.IsNone
            ? [self.CornerFace(corner)]
            : [self.CornerFace(corner), self.CornerFace(twin)];
    }
}
